info.name: Posit Connect API Reference API Keys Custom Documentation API

items.docs:
Retrieve the custom documentation for your Posit Connect server, formatted using Markdown.
Returns a 404 Not Found error if no custom documentation is configured.

Set the custom documentation for your Posit Connect server, formatted using Markdown.
The maximum length for the provided documentation is 500000 characters.
This action is only available to administrators.
Returns a 204 No Content response if the documentation was successfully set.

Delete the custom documentation for your Posit Connect server.
This action is only available to administrators.
Returns a 204 No Content response if the documentation was successfully deleted.
Returns a 404 Not Found error if no custom documentation is configured.
